blocks.content:
Members of Legislative Council are chosen as follows:
• One-third elected by Legislative Assembly members
• One-third elected by local authorities
• One-twelfth elected by teachers
• One-twelfth elected by graduates
• One-sixth nominated by Governor
Members of Legislative Council are chosen as follows:

items: Memorize the exact breakdown: 1/3 Assembly, 1/3 Local Authorities, 1/6 Governor Nomination, 1/12 Teachers, 1/12 Graduates.
5/6 of total members are elected, while only 1/6 are nominated by the Governor.
Questions frequently test the specific 1/12 proportion shared equally between teachers and graduates.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: One-third of the members are elected by Legislative Assembly members.
One-third of the members are elected by local authorities.
One-sixth of the total members are nominated by the Governor.
Teachers and graduates each elect one-twelfth of the Legislative Council members.
